'''Tulrus''' were large [[Egg/Legends|egg]]-laying beasts which could mainly be found roaming on and around the [[Tulrus Nesting Grounds]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], void of all other [[Species/Legends|species]] except the [[Jundak/Legends|jundak]]. For safety reasons, the tulrus usually traveled in small packs of two or more, and were very protective, and therefore aggressive if provoked. Their tusks were made from ivory. Legends claimed that a tulrus was trapped in an ancient [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] facility and had grown to a great size and strength. It was never proven true, for everyone who had entered the facility never came out alive. [[Tulrus sword|Swords]] could also be constructed from their bodies.

Due to their sheer size, the tulrus were very dangerous creatures, but they were not particularly smart. Due to their poor [[Eye/Legends|eyesight]] and bad temper, they often charged the instant they detected the presence of anything other than themselves. When attacking they used their large mass to knock their enemies off their feet, and then trample them to their [[Death/Legends|death]].

Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], one particularly ferocious tulrus named [[Foehorn]] attacked several miners. Chief [[Ulon Glost]] of the Mensix Mining Company hired a number of hunters to try to kill the beast.

[[File:MagmaHorn.jpg|200px|thumb|The magma horn was very similar in appearance to a normal tulrus.]]

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tulrus_concept_art.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
Tulrus appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online role-playing game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ToOW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Players could collect [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] from tulrus and use it to make tulrus pets and mounts for themselves.
